description: This PHP source file defines the Sale class within the Opencart admin report module. It provides methods to retrieve various sales and order statistics such as total sales, orders by country, day, week, month, year, as well as detailed order and tax information. The class interacts with the database to execute SQL queries and returns structured data for reporting purposes.
external_files: database tables: order, country, order_product, order_total

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: A model class for generating sales and order reports within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Returns the total sales amount, optionally filtered by date.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders and their total amount grouped by country.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByDay
methods.description: Returns the number of orders for each hour of the current day.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByWeek
methods.description: Returns the number of orders for each day of the current week.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of orders for each day of the current month.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByYear
methods.description: Returns the number of orders for each month of the current year.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves detailed order data with optional filters and grouping.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total count of orders based on filters and grouping.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Returns tax-related order data, grouped by day, week, month, or year.

methods.name: getTotalTaxes
methods.description: Returns the total number of tax records based on filters.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns shipping-related order data, grouped by day, week, month, or year.

methods.name: getTotalShipping
methods.description: Returns the total number of shipping records based on filters.
